title: 't Behouden Huys
text:
't Behouden Huys
't Behouden Huys
'
t Behouden Huys
or
Het Behouden Huis
is a
museum
in
West-Terschelling
, Netherlands.
The museum is named after the shelter used by
Willem Barentsz
on his third Arctic expedition, when they became trapped in ice off northern Russia.
[
2
]
The museum consists of several 17th-century buildings which were once the houses of wealthy whaling commanders.
[
1
]
The buildings were constructed in 1688.
[
1
]
The museum was established in 1938, and acquired these buildings in 1950.
[
1
]
During World War II the collection had to be hidden.
[
1
]
The building is
rijksmonument
35050.

3
]
